en.title: Clinical Psychology Practice Site — Designed and Coded Solo
en.tagline: A one-page practice site taken from reference to deployed in a week, alone.
en.description: Took a solo clinical psychologist's one-page site from first reference to deployed in a week, by myself: moodboard, style guide, a twelve-section page and a twelve-step token ramp, then built as a static Next.js export over thirteen bespoke section components. The booking mechanism is written as code rather than decoration — seven distinct WhatsApp deep links, one per entry point. The photography is AI-generated; no photographs were available to work from.
